overview_description.description: Adaptive Security provides a platform focused on security awareness training and simulated AI-driven cyber attacks to help organizations strengthen human defenses against evolving threats. It offers interactive training modules on topics such as deepfakes, smishing, and AI-generated attacks, and enables organizations to tailor content with an AI content creator for role-specific learning. The platform also runs multi-channel phishing simulations using customizable AI personas and real-world intelligence to mirror actual attack patterns. Additionally, it delivers risk monitoring features that quantify individual and organizational threat exposure and supports automated risk-based remediation workflows. This suite helps security teams assess and improve employee readiness against advanced cyber threats.

about_short_description.short_description: Adaptive Security provides training and phishing simulations to help organizations strengthen human defenses against evolving cyber threats.

product.name: Security Awareness Training
product.description: Cloud-based employee security training covering phishing, AI-powered attacks, deepfakes, voice scams, compliance, password security, physical security, and safe AI use.

product.name: Phishing Simulations
product.description: A phishing simulation platform for testing employee responses to realistic email, voice, SMS, chat, and deepfake attacks using organization-specific data and automated campaigns.

product.name: Cloud Email Security
product.description: Cloud email protection that detects and remediates AI-generated phishing, business email compromise, impersonation, malicious links, attachments, and malware.

product.name: AI Governance
product.description: AI usage governance software that discovers AI tools and unsanctioned applications, enforces acceptable-use policies, and provides in-browser coaching for policy violations.

product.name: Phish Triage
product.description: An AI-assisted workflow for classifying employee-reported emails as safe, spam, or malicious and automatically remediating matching messages across the organization.

product.name: Human Risk Monitoring
product.description: Continuous employee and group risk scoring that combines behavioral, HR, identity, email, and OSINT signals to identify exposure and trigger targeted mitigation actions.
